components.css: .ds-stage { position:relative; width:320px; height:120px; border-radius:28px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#e8eef7,#bcd6fb,#5aa7ff); overflow:hidden; font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-callout { position:absolute; left:80px; top:60px; width:0; height:0; } .ds-pin { position:absolute; left:-6px; top:-6px; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; background:#fff; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #0071e3, 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.3); } .ds-pill { position:absolute; left:22px; top:0; transform:translateY(-50%); padding:7px 14px 8px; border-radius:18px; white-space:nowrap; background:rgba(255,255,255,.78); -webkit-backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(18px); backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(18px); box-shadow:0 0 0 .5px rgba(0,0,0,.08), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18); color:#1d1d1f; } .ds-pill b { display:block; font-size:22px; line-height:1.1; font-weight:650; letter-spacing:-.03em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-pill span { display:block; font-size:12px; color:#6e6e73; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(0,113,227,.42); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
The app follows the HybriDock-Pep web app's design language: white and true-black pages, system-grey grouped surfaces, one blue accent, the platform's own font set run large and tight, hairlines instead of boxes, and pill buttons. The flow window is the product shot. It is the one saturated, moving thing on any screen, and everything else is quiet enough to let it read.

Density is calm and generous: a 1180px column, large display type on Home, grouped lists and big tabular figures elsewhere. Depth is mostly tonal. The flow carries the only chromatic range beyond the accent. Plain language is part of the look: figures are large, labels are short, and a small grey technical line sits under the plain one.

The direction was pinned by the user rather than rolled: follow HybriDock-Pep, with the chart restyled to match. The previous nautical-chart look (web_v2) is superseded.
keyCharacteristics: Two appearances, Light, Dark and Auto; data-theme is always set explicitly on the root.
One accent, swappable at runtime from five choices; everything accent-coloured reads --accent.
Grouped grey surfaces and hairlines, not bordered cards.
Pill buttons, 44px touch height, press scales to 0.97.
The flow window is the only place with a multi-hue ramp, and it is a GPU canvas.
Large tabular figures for results; units and plain meaning sit beside them.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Blue (or the chosen accent) is the only chromatic UI colour; the flow window is the only multi-hue surface. A screen with a coloured banner, a coloured card and a coloured button has lost the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Three Copies Rule
rules.body: The flow ramp exists in the shader, the legend gradient and the Guide swatch. They are not tokens and do not inherit. Edit all three or none.

rules.name: The Plain First Rule
rules.body: Plain wording leads, the technical term follows in small grey beneath it. Never lead with the symbol.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every changing or compared number uses tabular figures so values do not jitter.

rules.name: The No Stretch Rule
rules.body: The flow window's aspect follows what it shows (4:1 whole vessel, narrower for a close-up). Never letterbox or scale a frame to fit a slot.

rules.name: The Flat Until Floating Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest have no shadow. Only elements that hover above content get one, and the flow window itself is flat except on Home.

dos: Do keep the accent as the only UI colour and let the flow window carry the colour range.
Do group with the grey tone and hairlines before reaching for a border or a shadow.
Do give every button the pill shape and a 44px minimum touch height.
Do put window controls and labels in the bar below the window, and show figures through callouts.
Do set data-theme explicitly and design both appearances; read flow colours from the shader stops, not from CSS tokens.
Do lead with the plain name and put the technical term in small grey under it.
Do end entrance and pin motion on --ease-out or --ease-sheet.
donts: Don't stretch the window to fill a slot; change the view and the aspect together.
Don't place labels, controls or banners on top of the flow beyond callouts and the empty-state veil.
Don't introduce a second accent, gradient text or coloured card fills.
Don't add overshoot or bounce easing.
Don't treat the Home illustration as data; it stays labelled "Illustration only".
Don't add flow colours in only one of the three places the ramp lives.
